current.text: He signed with the San Antonio Spurs this offseason.
He strained his calf early in preseason and may not be ready for the start of the season. Yahoo lists him as questionable.
The Spurs started three guards (Fox, Harper and Castle) in the preseason.
He projects as a bench forward, not a starter. The projected starters are Fox, Harper, Castle, Vassell and Wembanyama.
The Spurs are very deep at forward, so his minutes are likely to be limited. Team minutes may also stay low after their long playoff run.
The front office is expected to consolidate its forward depth through trades in the near future.
With a March 28 end, the Spurs play 3, 4 and 3 games in the fantasy playoff weeks. They have only 13 back-to-backs.
His rim finishing fell to 58 percent last season, down from 68.
His rim finishing might bounce back in the Spurs offense.
Experts disagree on him as a late pick. One says do not draft him because of the calf and the Spurs' depth. Another says he is still value around pick 150.
His ESPN rank (about 93) is too high. Avoid him at that price.
He has limited upside and is not a flyer. He is a late pick only if you need a steady scorer and rebounder.

durable.text: He is a very good defensive rebounder for a power forward.
He is a strong isolation and post scorer whom the team can hand the ball to when the offense bogs down.
He is streaky from three, but defenses still have to respect his shot.
His category profile is flat. His FT% is good and he has few turnovers, but no category is weak and none is a league outlier.

note: He is a fringe player for our 144-player draft. Yahoo has him at 0 USD and rank 156, ESPN at 3 USD and rank 93, and he went for 1 USD in our league last season. Pay 1 USD at most, or leave him for waivers, since a calf strain and a likely bench role behind the Spurs' three-guard lineup cap his minutes. His flat profile (good FT%, few turnovers) fits any build as filler. Early in the season, check when the calf heals and whether he gets the starting power forward spot or regular 28 plus minutes.
